items.title: Achieve missing from ChatGPT's picks for "best personal loans"
items.why: audits.com lending AI index (US, UK, AU; 3,385 answers): for "best personal loans" in the US, SoFi is named in 92% of ChatGPT runs and 100% of Google AI Overviews; LightStream is Gemini's top pick (94%); Upstart is ChatGPT's most frequent first pick. Achieve is not among the 8 brands ChatGPT names (LendingClub is at 8%). ChatGPT cites first-party brand sites 96% of the time, against 35% for AI Overviews. Treat as directional: the index uses one prompt. Achieve's own /personal-loans facts are what ChatGPT would cite.
items.fix: Strengthen first-party /personal-loans facts and comparable owned pages that AI answers can cite.
items.severityBasis: Market Scout 2026-11-16 marks this directional (one prompt) and does not label P0, High, Medium or Low

items.title: No credit-card-debt statistics page on FDR, Achieve or bills.com
items.why: Market Scout found no credit-card-debt statistics page on FDR, Achieve or bills.com: four guessed paths returned 404, and no stats URL turned up in the FDR or Achieve sitemaps. NY Fed Q3 shows cards at $1.285T and a widening delinquency gap by income — a hook with no owned page to put it on.
items.fix: Publish one credit-card-debt statistics page (or a clearly linked cluster) on at least one of the three brands. This is a content gap, not a missing graph node — do not invent a URL.

items.title: FDR /scam/ needs an advance-fee and impersonation block (DFPI hook)
items.why: FDR's /scam/ page still has no impersonation or advance-fee copy. The DFPI's September actions, published 12 Nov 2026, include E-Capital Inc. (ordered to stop charging upfront fees for debt-relief services it never performed) and Frontier Legal Group (fake lawsuits and wage-garnishment threats). Together with FTC Arizona and the GA AG, that is three states in three weeks. /scam/ is in the crawl as an 'other' page, so it rolls up to the FDR brand node (it is not a drawn product-hub page).
items.fix: Add an advance-fee and impersonation block to /scam/, using the DFPI E-Capital action as a hook. Compliance to word it.
